title: 6 SIGNS YOU’RE ABOUT TO MAKE A BAD DECISION
paragraphs: 6 SIGNS YOU’RE ABOUT TO MAKE A BAD DECISION
If this found you… it’s not by accident.

Because most bad decisions don’t feel wrong at the start.
They feel justified.
They feel urgent.
They feel like you deserve this.
But here’s what most people don’t realize…
The moment before a wrong decision is often the quietest spiritual battle you’ll ever face.
And if you don’t recognize it—you’ll walk straight into something that costs more than you planned to pay.
(Stay with me—this gets deeper.)
1. You’re Rushing When God Is Not
You feel pressured. Pushed. Like you have to decide now.
But Scripture cuts through the noise:
“The plans of the diligent lead surely to abundance, but everyone who is hasty comes only to poverty.” — Proverbs 21:5

God doesn’t rush you into confusion.
Pressure is often the voice of the flesh… not the Spirit.
And yet—you’re about to click, say yes, respond, act…
Why the urgency?
2. You’re Ignoring That Inner Warning
You felt it. That hesitation. That check in your spirit.
But you’re explaining it away.
“My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me.” — John 10:27

That discomfort?
It’s not anxiety.
It might be God trying to stop you.
Read that again.
3. You’re Justifying What You Know Is Wrong
You’ve built a whole argument for it.

“It’s not that bad.”
“No one will know.”
“I deserve this.”
But the Word doesn’t bend for convenience:
“There is a way that seems right to a man, but its end is the way to death.” — Proverbs 14:12

Seems right…
Feels right…
Still leads to destruction.
4. You Don’t Want Wise Counsel
You’ve stopped asking godly people.
Because deep down—you already know what they’ll say.
“Where there is no guidance, a people falls, but in an abundance of counselors there is safety.” — Proverbs 11:14

Isolation is dangerous.
Especially when you’re deciding something big.
5. You’re Led by Emotion, Not Truth
Anger. Loneliness. Desire. Pride.
Your emotions are loud right now.
But God’s truth is steady:
“The heart is deceitful above all things, and desperately sick; who can understand it?” — Jeremiah 17:9

Feelings can lie.
God’s Word doesn’t.
6. You Haven’t Brought It to God Honestly
Not a quick prayer. Not a surface-level “God bless this.”
Real surrender.
Because here’s the truth:
“Trust in the Lord with all your heart, and do not lean on your own understanding. In all your ways acknowledge Him, and He will make straight your paths.” — Proverbs 3:5–6
You’re about to make a decision…
But have you actually surrendered it?
Or are you asking God to approve something you’ve already chosen?
THE BREAKING POINT
Let’s be real.
This isn’t just about bad decisions.
It’s about sin.
“For all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God.” — Romans 3:23
Every wrong decision—at its root—is separation from God.
And no amount of “trying harder” fixes that.
THE GOSPEL (THE ONLY WAY OUT)
But here’s the turning point.
The moment everything changes.
“But God shows His love for us in that while we were still sinners, Christ died for us.” — Romans 5:8
Jesus didn’t wait for you to get it right.
He stepped into your wrong.
Took your sin.
Paid your debt.
“For by grace you have been saved through faith… not a result of works.” — Ephesians 2:8–9
This is not behavior modification.
This is transformation.
Through Christ alone.
RESOLUTION
You don’t need a better strategy.
You need surrender.
You don’t need to manage sin.
You need a Savior.
And His name is Jesus.
Originally written by Gospel Warrior.
And when you’re ready to go deeper—this is where transformation begins:
Because this is only the surface.
If this found you… it’s not by accident.
